revision_note: 2026-10-14 (DECISION-012): records the outcome of an appeal hearing. The appeal is the hash-verified APPEAL_FILED block for the household's current notice; the outcome can be recorded on or after the hearing date (Asia/Manila). GRANTED: NOTICE_OF_INELIGIBILITY -> ACTIVE_COMPLIANT, sealed as BENEFICIARY_RETAINED (decision APPEAL_GRANTED), with the same 180-day re-flag cooldown as retention. DENIED: NOTICE_OF_INELIGIBILITY -> GRADUATED, sealed as BENEFICIARY_GRADUATED (decision GRADUATION_COMPLETED, appeal_outcome DENIED). A calamity moratorium blocks a DENIED outcome but not a GRANTED one.

request.decision_notes: Hearing found the sedan belongs to a relative abroad; household income remains below threshold.

request_rules.decision_notes: required; 10 to 1000 characters; the hearing's stated grounds. No other field is accepted.

response_rules.reassessment_allowed_from: present for GRANTED; null for DENIED
